topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecturer's opening remarks and introduces the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen- and damage-associated molecular patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics outline how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular injury through molecular patterns that distinguish foreign and damaged structures from healthy self.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and inflammatory signaling cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genomic encoding, cellular localization, and downstream activation pathways of key pattern recognition receptor families and the inflammasome complex.

topics.label: Cellular activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammatory consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics follow the physiological progression of an inflammatory response from sentinel cell stimulation and leukocyte tissue recruitment to lymphatic antigen transport and the systemic danger of septic shock.

topics.label: Inflammation resolution, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory adaptations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the active and passive mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and manage persistent or unresolvable insults through chronic structures such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of the next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic marks the conclusion of the lecture and announces the topic of the following session.
